# OSHA 10 & 30-Hour Construction Outreach Training with DOL Card

> OSHA 10 & 30-Hour Construction Outreach Training with DOL Card: 3 self-paced online courses from $89.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [OSHA 10-Hour Outreach Training for Construction Industry with DOL Card](https://osha-30-construction.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-478): $89.99 per person, 10 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 60 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926. Enroll: https://osha-30-construction.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=478.
